_readme: Reference index for Cursor rules to reason about. Scope is intentionally narrow: ONLY registries that install through the actual shadcn CLI/MCP (`npx shadcn add ...`), nothing that needs its own separate CLI, and nothing that's copy-paste-only. Does NOT make a registry installable on its own — that's controlled by components.json. Confidence levels below reflect vendor-docs checks done 2026-07-13.
_scope: Only registries confirmed to work via `npx shadcn add @namespace/component` (or, for 21st.dev, a direct shadcn-compatible URL) are listed. Libraries with their own separate CLI (e.g. a `magicui-cli`/`vengeance-cli`-style tool that ISN'T the shadcn CLI), pure copy-paste sites, and non-component reference sites (design inspiration, DESIGN.md libraries) have been deliberately excluded — they don't belong in a 'shadcn-only' registry list even if they were useful as general references.

_confidence_levels.confirmed: Checked the vendor's own install/docs page directly.
_confidence_levels.unverified: Not confirmed against the vendor's own docs — excluded from this file until checked.

_default_policy.note: Unless the user explicitly asks for a paid/pro component or confirms a license key is configured, only install from each registry's free tier. Registries with a requires_key_for field have paid components that must NOT be installed by default.

registries.name: shadcn/ui
registries.notes: The base registry. Configured by default via `shadcn init`. Always free. Includes official blocks (login, dashboard, marketing sections) at https://ui.shadcn.com/blocks — check there before anything else for structural pieces like navbars, sidebars, login forms.

registries.name: @shadcn-space
registries.notes: Free + premium split. Free components install via the standard @shadcn-space/{name} namespace once added to components.json. Premium requires email + license key — do not install by default.

registries.name: @unlumen-ui
registries.notes: Free tier installs with no key. Pro requires UNLUMEN_LICENSE_KEY — do not install by default.

registries.name: @smoothui
registries.notes: Official shadcn registry, built into the CLI — @smoothui namespace works with no components.json entry needed. Fully free.

registries.name: @magic-ui
registries.notes: Open source shadcn registry, confirmed real registry.json. Fully free (Magic UI Pro templates are a separate paid product — do not confuse with this free component registry).

registries.name: @react-bits
registries.notes: docs_url category segment unverified (exact slug per category not checked) — confirm before trusting a generated link. Registry itself confirmed free.

registries.name: @vengeanceui
registries.notes: Confirmed via their own site: `npx shadcn add @vengeanceui/[component]`. Individual component doc URL pattern not confirmed.

registries.name: 21st.dev
registries.notes: Not a simple namespace registry — installs via a full per-component URL through the shadcn CLI, not a components.json shortcut. Community-submitted, so quality/free-vs-paid varies by author; check each item.

_excluded_deliberately: aceternity-ui — its /components section is copy-paste only (no shadcn registry endpoint), and its /blocks section's shadcn-compatibility was never confirmed against Aceternity's own docs. Excluded until verified.
dark.design, styles.refero.design — not component registries at all (inspiration / design-token references). Out of scope for a shadcn-only list.
supahero.io, getlayers.ai — install method never confirmed. Excluded rather than guessed.
_how_to_add_a_registry: 1. Confirm on the vendor's OWN docs (not an aggregator) that it installs via `npx shadcn add` — that's the bar for inclusion in this file.
2. Add the registry to components.json with its registry_url (and auth headers if it requires a key). This is what makes it functionally installable — this file is reference only.
3. Add an entry here with confidence: 'confirmed' only after that direct check, and set requires_key_for if any part of it is paid.
